=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
WorkItem is identified by WorkItemId.
WorkItemId is a value of type String.
WorkState is a value of type String.
Reviewer is identified by ReviewerId.
ReviewerId is a value of type String.
Note is identified by NoteId.
NoteId is a value of type String.
Priority is a value of type Integer.
Effort is identified by a value in h (Duration).

=== Fact Types ===
WorkItem has state WorkState
  - item: WorkItem (String)
  - state: WorkState (String)

WorkItem is reviewed by Reviewer
  - item: WorkItem (String)
  - reviewer: Reviewer (String)

WorkItem has note Note
  - item: WorkItem (String)
  - note: Note (String)

WorkItem has priority Priority
  - item: WorkItem (String)
  - priority: Priority (Integer)

=== Operations ===
WorkItem gains review note Note from Reviewer
  - item: WorkItem (String)
  - note: Note (String)
  - reviewer: Reviewer (String)

WorkItem is flagged
  - item: WorkItem (String)
